object.description: No test reads or writes a row span. Hand-write a 2-column, 2-row table whose first cell has rowspan="2" and whose second row holds one cell; read it. Set the same table through Mellon and read the file. Expected: the first cell spans two rows, and the second row's cell sits in column 2; the written cell carries rowspan="2".
